caption:
Stock market news | Reserve Bank of India net $6.94 bn for fourth month

The Reserve Bank of India recorded a net purchase of $6.94 bn in the foreign exchange market in September, buying $82.18 bn and selling $75.25 bn.
The inflow of about $143 bn supports the rupee and shows foreign investors' confidence, influencing Indian equity markets.
